hotels.title: Relaxing Canberra Escape with Daily Breakfast & Parking
hotels.description: Embrace Australia's intimate and cultured capital city with a stylish lakeside stay at a beautifully appointed property near Lake Ginninderra. Make use of the hotel's fitness centre, savour a meal at Selections Bistro, located in the adjoining Canberra Labor Club, or simply relax in your stylish and cosy room after a day exploring the city. Venture out to discover the city's iconic landmarks, including the Australian War Memorial and National Gallery of Australia, or indulge in retail therapy at the Canberra Centre. For nature enthusiasts, scenic national parks beckon, sports aficionados will appreciate proximity to major stadiums such as GIO Stadium Canberra. With a wine tasting upgrade available, you can explore one of the many wineries in the region, Mount Majura Vineyard, and sample its world-class wines.
